style.title: 🎨 Style Lock (keep a series consistent)
style.note: Tune the generation parameters below and press "Capture current parameters", fill in the style prefix and seed, then turn the lock on. Every generation afterwards (including batches) uses the same settings. Note: a fixed seed stabilizes composition and color, but results can still differ between prompts; pair it with a fixed checkpoint / LoRA.

engine.note.sdxl: Stable Diffusion format: weights are written as (tag:weight); paste the negative prompt into the Negative field.
engine.note.midjourney: Default version: no --v flag; adds --ar and converts the negative prompt to --no (up to 10 terms). No :: weights — weights only affect order, and tags below 0.5 are omitted.
engine.note.midjourney-7: Adds --v 7 and --ar, and converts the negative prompt to --no (up to 10 terms). V7 does not support :: weights, so weights only affect order and tags below 0.5 are omitted.
engine.note.midjourney-6: Adds --v 6.1 and --ar, converts weights to :: syntax and the negative prompt to --no (up to 10 terms).
engine.note.leonardo: No weight syntax: weights only affect order and tags below 0.5 are omitted. Paste the negative prompt into the Negative prompt field.
engine.note.ideogram: Outputs a natural sentence; weights become "emphasize" or "subtle" wording. If the interface has a Negative prompt field, paste the negative prompt there.
engine.note.dalle3: Outputs a natural sentence; weights become "emphasize" or "subtle" wording. DALL·E 3 has no negative prompt, so the negative terms are rewritten as a trailing "Avoid" sentence.
gen.sdFormatNote: Local generation always uses the Stable Diffusion prompt format, regardless of the selected image engine.
